signal.mechanism: Nonpositive excess corporate-bond premium may indicate accommodating risk appetite/credit intermediation and support equity demand. US-to-MOEX transmission can fail under sanctions/capital controls and local commodity/policy shocks. High EBP can also forecast higher long-horizon returns, so this direction is a hypothesis, not an established trading law.
signal.primary: MIX long0.9 iff latest complete available ebp<=0, otherwise cash. Exact Decimal sign; real zero is long. No moving averages, training, magnitude threshold grid or trend overlay.
signal.control: Constant MIX long0.9 on identical readiness/calendar. Diagnostic only, cannot be promoted/tuned after outcomes.
signal.missing: Missing latest ebp masks primary and control; no zero imputation, interpolation or older-good fallback. Whole monthly calendar gap, duplicate date, malformed/nonfinite selected ebp or schema drift fails closed. Other/protected-date cells and unrelated columns are ignored before value interpretation.
